extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology; claims are limited to paper-local biophysical/NMR/MD evidence and do not promote reference-only text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptides in this morphing series adopt alpha-helical structure under membrane-mimetic conditions; helicity is a necessary but insufficient feature for activity/selectivity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The helical signal supports structural context but does not alone explain antimicrobial selectivity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: For peptide 14, MD, hydropathy analysis, and NMR support a flexible C-terminal region and an oblique-oriented membrane-invasion hypothesis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The membrane-invasion model is a supported hypothesis rather than a direct pathogen-cell killing mechanism measurement.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptide 6 ruptured giant POPC vesicles in a microfluidic chamber, supporting membranolytic activity in a model lipid-vesicle system.
direct_assay_types: giant POPC vesicle rupture imaging in a microfluidic chamber
mechanism_claims.limitations: The vesicle experiment is a model-membrane observation and should not be overextended to an exact bacterial-cell pore architecture.
